seoTitle: Random Color Generator with Hue, Saturation and Lightness Ranges
metaDescription: Generate random colours inside hue, saturation and lightness limits, for tags, avatars and tests. Free, local.
intro: Creates up to 500 random colours inside the hue, saturation and lightness ranges you set, shown as swatches and HEX codes.
why:
Pure random colours are often muddy. Limits make them useful: for example hue 0 to 360 with saturation 50 to 70 and lightness 70 to 85 gives pastels for tags or chart series. Set a narrow hue range for a themed set.

Colours are made in HSL and shown as HEX. The generator is random each run, so copy the ones you want.
howTo: Set how many colours you need.
Set the hue, saturation and lightness ranges.

faq.q: Can I get the same colours again?
faq.a: No, there is no seed. Copy the list.

faq.q: Why do some colours look similar in brightness?
faq.a: HSL lightness is not perceptual. Use the Palette Shuffler for even weight.
Yes, with limited saturation and lightness the text stays readable.
